issue: चमन सदा सुख सम्पत्ति भर दो — चमन is read as the poet's signature (Chaman), as the README has it; the word also means 'a garden', which would give 'fill the garden (of one's life) with happiness and wealth'.
our reading: Fill Chaman (the poet) always with happiness and wealth.
alternatives: चमन = garden: fill the garden always with happiness and wealth
